source.note: 1995 Select Baseball was a Hobby-only single-series release. VCS models the 250 cards actually available in packs as the flagship Base ProductSet, plus the four verified pack-inserted families. Hideo Nomo #251 and its Artist's Proof counterpart were dealer/case-order issues rather than pack pulls and are intentionally excluded, as are the four-card Samples promo set.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: VCS-normalized pack: 4 cards per pack, 24 packs per box. The physical Hobby product was documented as 12 cards per pack; VCS uses the standing four-card pack rule while preserving verified per-pack insert frequencies.
decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: Base #1-250 is the pack-pullable collector checklist and all 250 cards share equal base availability for completion and prestige tracking.
decisions.dealerCardHandling: Hideo Nomo #251 was distributed to qualifying hobby dealers and was not inserted in packs. It is excluded from the VCS Base ProductSet. The corresponding Artist's Proof #251 is excluded for the same reason.
decisions.promoHandling: The three player Samples plus information/title card were pre-release promotional material and are excluded from the VCS pack product.
decisions.artistProofRepresentation: Artist's Proofs are modeled as a 250-card derived parallel of Base #1-250. TCDB catalogs 251 records because it also includes dealer-only #251, which VCS intentionally excludes from pack play.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: Append RC to Player only for the seven cards currently recognized by TCDB's Rookie Cards index. Select Rookie (SR) source notation alone does not create an RC designation.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains the clean card subject name plus verified RC when applicable. TCDB source codes such as SR, ST, CL, and UER are kept out of Player; checklist identity is stored in Subset and other source metadata may be retained in Variant.
decisions.oddsPlacement: Verified pack odds live only on ProductSets. No card Variant contains set-wide insertion odds.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until pack/card images and pricing are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Pack-issued flagship checklist #1-250. Dealer-only Hideo Nomo #251 is intentionally excluded.

productSets.name: Artist's Proofs
productSets.notes: Pack-issued Artist's Proof parallel of Base #1-250, inserted 1:24 packs. TCDB's dealer-only #251 Artist's Proof is intentionally excluded.
